tasks.goal: Use the word 'bifocal'

tasks.goal: Use the word 'refraction'
tasks.hint: Refraction is the optical measurement of eye focusing errors during an eye exam. Ask if a digital refraction measurement is performed prior to lens fitting.
tasks.done_when: Learner used the word 'refraction'.
